plainText:
Motoko Kumai (Japanese: まいもとこ Kumai Motoko) is a Japanese voice actress for and .

==Biography==
Kumai was born on September 8, 1970 in , , and became a voice actress as an adult. She has frequently voiced characters in various episodes since of the . Kumai is currently affiliated with the talent agency . From December 21, 2006, to October 2007, Motoko took a sabbatical after coming down with an illness that required medical treatment.
